subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix inbound image leaves agent turn unresolved; Matrix send queue hits fetch failed, then gateway reloads after ~60s

question: Should this be investigated first as a Matrix plugin failure-classification and turn-settlement bug, or split into a gateway reload-attribution investigation before code changes?
rationale: The source path is clear enough to keep the issue open, but the observed behavior spans Matrix encrypted media, outbound send queue errors, active turn lifecycle, and gateway reload handling, so automation should not choose the repair boundary without live proof.

options.title: Reproduce Matrix flow first
options.body: Run a live Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room image repro on current main and use that trace to decide whether the fix belongs in Matrix send/media handling, gateway reload attribution, or both.

options.title: Split gateway diagnostics
options.body: Open or link a narrower gateway diagnostics item if live proof shows reload attribution is separate from Matrix turn settlement.

options.title: Close as adjacent fixed work
options.body: Close only if a maintainer can point to a merged current-main fix that covers the combined outbound `fetch failed`, unresolved turn, and reload behavior.

recommendation.title: Reproduce Matrix flow first
recommendation.body: Run a live Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room image repro on current main and use that trace to decide whether the fix belongs in Matrix send/media handling, gateway reload attribution, or both.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Matrix delivery replay work is the closest current-main history to send failure retry and turn-settlement policy.
